learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles and modules for Optoelectronic transfer.
Identify and apply tasks in the field of optoelectronics.

syllabus_topics: Transmission properties of optical fibers ond cabels.
Basic manipulation with optic devices and components, cleaning of connectors, connecting, bare fiber adapters.
Direct and undirect methodes of attenuation measurement.
Measurement of optical fibers attenuation in dependence on bending diameter.
teaching_methods: Teaching by an expert (lecture or tutorial)
